description: Prepare an indicative estimate and durable manufacturing checklist for a whole CAD assembly, including mixed materials and processes. The server reads material and sheet thickness from CAD, selects supported processes, checks live supplier offers, and reports any missing prices or blockers. This creates only a draft estimate. It does not send an order, charge the customer, or start checkout. Sign in to estimate private saved projects; source code and public projects can be estimated as a guest.

assembly.description: Assembly name when the script contains multiple assemblies.

params.description: Current CAD parameter values. Materials and sheet thickness come from the CAD design.

projectSlug.description: Saved project slug. Use this for a saved assembly.

source.description: Current kernelCAD source for an unsaved assembly.
